facts.text: `#selectModel` in `.pi/lib/tern/bridge.ts` returns early with "model selection unavailable in this Pi session" when `session.modelRuntime` or `session.setModel` is missing. It loads the catalog with `getAvailableSnapshot()`, then refreshes it with `getAvailable()` when present.

Pi owns the provider/agent loop, session manager, native tools, and terminal UI. This repository adds Swarm behavior through Pi ExtensionAPI entrypoints at `extensions/<extension>/index.ts`. Semantic state, authorization, persistence, and cancellation must not depend on whether a TUI frame rendered.

Release metadata lives in `package.json`, `update-manifest.json`, and `CHANGELOG.md`. The CI job `release-metadata` requires the manifest package and version to match `package.json` and requires a `## [version]` section in CHANGELOG.md. The manifest uses source `git:github.com/cloverinternational/trebol@main` and updateCommand `pi update --extensions`.

The CI `changelog` job fails any pull request whose diff does not modify `CHANGELOG.md`, with the entry expected under `[Unreleased]`. The `build-test` job runs on Node 24 with `npm ci`, `npm run build`, `node tools/repo/rewrite-imports.mjs --check`, `npm test`, and `npm run test:ask-user`.
